diagnosis.observed: Literal canonical paths now open on Windows and all applicable core tests and strict Clippy pass. The complete Windows job still fails: three standalone tests cannot immediately delete SQLite files (OS error 32).
causes: Temporary validation and VACUUM pools were dropped without awaiting graceful closure. Temporary document/blob readers also returned early on query errors without awaiting closure.

SQLx 0.8.6 Pool::close has a return-to-pool race: an already-returning connection can be requeued after the idle drain; the final semaphore wait can then return without draining it. A controlled after_release fixture reproduces pool.size() == 1 after close on Linux.

reproduction.before: Linux controlled return/close sequence: assertion failed, left: 1, right: 0.
reproduction.after: The regression awaits close_pool and asserts pool.size() == 0, with no sleeps or file-deletion retries.

diagnosis.candidateFix: Await complete pool drain for regular and temporary pools on both successful and failed operations; keep all immediate deletion assertions and Windows tests.
